passives.name: Elf-Style Hand Seals
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants A Ninja's Afterimage to the caster. (Triggered Effect) When an ally is inflicted with a debuff, activates an Agile Response. Removes 1 debuff from all allies, and has a [Buff_C_2000072_2_6] chance to inflict Unhealable on all enemies for [Buff_T_2000072_2_6] turn(s).
